name: sumAcc_zero
prelude:
def mySum : List Nat → Nat
  | [] => 0
  | x :: xs => x + mySum xs

def sumAcc : List Nat → Nat → Nat
  | [], acc => acc
  | x :: xs, acc => sumAcc xs (acc + x)
statement: theorem sumAcc_zero (xs : List Nat) : sumAcc xs 0 = mySum xs
proofs:
have invariant (zs : List Nat) (a : Nat) : sumAcc zs a = a + mySum zs := by
    induction zs generalizing a with
    | nil => simp [sumAcc, mySum]
    | cons z zs ih => simp [sumAcc, mySum, ih, Nat.add_assoc]
  simpa using invariant xs 0
  have shift (zs : List Nat) (a b : Nat) : sumAcc zs (a + b) = sumAcc zs a + b := by
    induction zs generalizing a with
    | nil => rfl
    | cons z zs ih => simpa [sumAcc, Nat.add_assoc, Nat.add_comm, Nat.add_left_comm] using ih (a + z)
  induction xs with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons x xs ih =>
    simp only [sumAcc, Nat.zero_add, mySum]
    have h := shift xs 0 x
    simp only [Nat.zero_add] at h
    rw [h, ih, Nat.add_comm]
strategies: Generalize the accumulator to obtain its relation to mySum.
Prove accumulator translation independently, then induct on xs at accumulator zero.
